# Quaternius Universal Base Characters — LIFEBOX LIVE subset

Source pack: **Universal Base Characters — Standard** by Quaternius  
Official page: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters.html  
Official itch.io: https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters  
License: **CC0 1.0 Universal / Public Domain Dedication**

Mirror used to reproduce source bytes:
https://github.com/NafisRayan/Animate-Rigged-Humanoid-No-Blender

Vendored source characters:
- Superhero_Male_FullBody
- Superhero_Female_FullBody

The glTF JSON keeps the original geometry, skin weights, skeleton hierarchy and bind data,
but references only diffuse/base-color textures. Normal/roughness textures are omitted to
keep the project lighter. Presentation use only; simulation authority is unchanged.
